name: Claude Code v2.1.232–233 — Subagent Forking Default, @-mentions, GitLab MR Support
hook: Two releases landed August 13–14. v2.1.232 turns subagent forking on by default — a `subagent_type: "fork"` agent now inherits the full conversation and prompt cache with no extra setup — and adds @-mention syntax: type `@` in any prompt to name another live Claude session and send it a message directly via SendMessage. v2.1.233 ships GitLab merge request support in `--worktree` and `claude agents` view (MRs render as `!N`), a Linux memory cgroup guard for runaway builds (`CLAUDE_CODE_TOOL_MEMORY_LIMIT`), and removes the built-in todo/task-tracking tools from Opus 4.8+, Sonnet 5, Fable 5, and Mythos 5 — restore them with `CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TODO_TOOLS=1`.

name: Claude Compliance API Now Covers Claude Code + Cowork — Enterprise Beta
hook: Announced August 11: the Compliance API — previously limited to Claude chat — now extends to Claude Cowork (desktop, web, and mobile) and Claude Code (CLI and desktop app). Enterprise beta. Security and compliance teams pull unified session content and metadata for audits and eDiscovery through the same API interface they already use for Claude conversations, with tamper-evident audit logs that support agency ATO processes. Coverage spans both interactive and programmatic Claude Code sessions.

name: Claude Code Auto Mode Default — Day 4; Now Live for All Pro/Max/Team Plans
hook: Auto mode went live August 14 as the default permission mode for all Pro, Max, and Team sessions. A classifier blocks any action deemed irreversible, destructive, or outside your environment — when blocked, Claude usually finds a safer path or asks. Internal tests with 1,053 paid users found auto mode caught 89% of dangerous commands vs 13.6% for human review (humans approve 97% of prompts reflexively). Trajectory Labs ran 720 prompt injection attacks; auto mode blocked all 720. Config: Shift+Tab cycles modes mid-session; set defaultMode or disableAutoMode in managed settings. Enterprise and API follow in September.
recurring_note: ↑ Day 4 — Live for 1 day across all Pro/Max/Team plans; Enterprise + API in September

name: thedotmack/claude-mem — ~90.8K Stars; Day 9; Persistent Context Across Sessions

Works with Claude Code, OpenCode, Codex, and Gemini CLI.
